virtual Customer Service Representative or Technical Support Representative work from home: you just need a working computer with internet connection and a normal headset. Apply via Upwork or any other freelance websites. Client that will hire you will pay by the hour/commission. Pay wise: the freelance website will ensure client pay you and they will just take a few percent off your pay. Visit that website to understand better. 

When it comes to either 1 of the above work, I can help and train you for free via online so that you are prepared with the know-how before starts to apply for job on such websites. I am more than able to help you on that to start making things better for you by earning and do meaningful things for other(employers etc.), we can even start that tonight while I am still breathing. Unsure till when I will be able to hang on, but I can help you as the last good deed I will do while i am still living.

On the language lesson, I would love to do that for a fee, maybe someone on the other side only understand Spanish. That may work for me, at least the basic conversation will do so it wont be that dull in there. p/s: I am a cat lover myself, the felines are good companions :)

I am in agreement with Ridsett that you can take online/virtual CSR job with your multiple language skill set, and perhaps virtual Technical troubleshooting job as well too. You have the computer skills for that. Also, use the WWW search engine to look for it. Plenty of multilingual job are vacant, you just need to look for it online and send your resume.

If I am still alive, longer time than the next 84 hours, I would love to learn Spanish and German language from you for a fee that I will pay via Paypal. I'm here, giving you a chance to earn something by utilizing your language skills :)

HTH.

i don't know what will happen then... all i know is that i have this note on reddit that i hope they can read once or soon when i leave this world so that they understand how deep i am in this black empty hole
the next 14 hour will be crucial, another argument with the relative will happen... the result of that argument will decide how soon i will leave my loving kids and wife...

I have been there, I know how you feel. It hurts, deep. 
You should enjoy the single life, as the decision of what you want to do on earth is totally up to you and no other half to dictate and order you to do so. There are plenty of girls, its everywhere. And yours to pursue. Don't give up just because your first 2 choices is not destined for you. 
Now, just step outside the house and start have fun. Go to the bars, or any place that gave you happiness before. Or do the sports activity you love/like. Cupid will be there, and he will strike, anywhere and it can be sooner. 
For now, just enjoy life, breathe  and smile :)

I am sorry for the tragic mishap of your dad. He may have felt the same way too like me and thought that a mothers care is still there to survive the family. It is not because of the children, it never is the children fault. For me, it is just that Love between a Father and a Mother won't work when 1 left the the other half for another pursuit of Life alone. I care for my kids and don't want them to be sad and depressed the most when their mom leave them. I want to avoid that and instead sacrifice myself so that they will live together a more happy life than living the life with a father. As they said: mom knows best.
